notes.subject: וחלה חרב
notes.rationale: KJV 'the sword shall abide' vs ASV/JPS 'shall fall' vs BSB 'will flash through' — Hebrew verb חלה ranges over whirl/flash/attack.

notes.subject: bainat
notes.rationale: חרב literally 'drought; cutting instrument' — rendered 'bainat' per discipline.

notes.subject: בדיו
notes.rationale: 'bars' (of gates) vs KJV 'branches' — the word בד covers limb, branch, and bar.

translation: Na bainat i wok long ⟨em⟩ i stanap long ol siti bilong en, na em i pinisim ol banis bilong en, na em i kaikaiim ⟨את⟩ olgeta — bilong ol tingting bilong ol yet.

tokens.gloss: bilong ol tingting bilong ol yet
